clinical_diagnosis_summary: Comprehensive kinetic chain circuit (4 protocols) prescribed for David Miller (34 yo) addressing Shoulder & Neck with visual EMA compensation monitoring and axial stability.
precautions: Moderate symptom threshold (6/10). Maintain neutral spinal alignment and eliminate compensatory shrug or trunk lateral flexion.

exercises.protocol_name: P8: Carpal Tunnel Wrist & Forearm Extension
exercises.clinical_rationale: Mobilizes median nerve glide across flexor retinaculum without trapezius tension.
Restores humeroulnar flexion and avoids compensatory shoulder abduction swing.
Strengthens deep cervical flexors and retrains neutral craniovertebral alignment.
Retrains bilateral serratus anterior activation and symmetric scapulohumeral rhythm.
